description: This file contains shell scripts providing helper functions for testing git commit-graph features. It includes functions for initializing the OID cache, comparing git operation modes with different commit-graph settings, and reading commit-graph data for testing purposes.

methods.name: graph_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares git operations with commit-graph enabled and disabled to ensure consistency.

methods.name: graph_git_behavior
methods.description: Tests various git commands to verify they produce the same results with and without commit-graph.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Reads and compares commit-graph data for testing, based on specified options.
